card.name: Start of split drug and brand names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug or brand name that is split into several parts, such as H in Hib, F in FANAPT, U in UZEDY or Lyn in Lynparza. It also fires on odd breaks inside long medical words.

modes.label: Brand name starts
modes.description: First letters of an uppercase or brand drug name, often right after 'with' or 'of'.

modes.label: Inside split medical words
modes.description: A break partway through a longer generic or medical term.
modes.example: Fenofibric acid delayed-release capsule is contrain<<d>>icated in patients with severe renal impairment,

modes.label: Abbreviation or section number starts
modes.description: The first character of an abbreviation or numbered section reference.
modes.example: Streptococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus influenzae type b (<<H>>ib) infections

card.writes: It slightly favors word-continuing pieces like 'glob' and 'able', but the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It lights up on the first letters of a drug name that the model reads in several pieces.
